blocks.text:
Day 1 · Arrival in Rio de Janeiro. At the international airport, meet your driver and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure.

Rio de Janeiro is a spectacular blend of green mountains, golden beaches, blue waters and vibrant city life. Discover its iconic coastline, from the legendary beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema to the breathtaking landscapes around Guanabara Bay. With its unique combination of natural beauty, culture, music and Brazilian joie de vivre, Rio is the perfect introduction to a journey through South America.
Copacabana Beach with swimmers, umbrellas and mountains on the horizon, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
